job.title: Director of IT Services
job.description:
Duration: 12 months to start 

Position Description:
  • The client administers the state's Medicaid program, providing healthcare coverage to eligible Mississippians. The client Office of Information Technology Management supports the agency's mission through enterprise technology services spanning cloud infrastructure, networking, service desk operations, cybersecurity, application integration, and vendor management.
  • The client is undergoing a significant technology modernization effort that includes migration of enterprise workloads to cloud platforms, implementation of federal interoperability mandates, adoption of cloud-native services, and restructuring of IT service delivery operations.

  • The contractor shall serve as a key member of the IT leadership team, reporting to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and/or Chief Technology Officer (CTO), and shall be responsible for the day-to-day management of infrastructure operations, cloud services, vendor relationships, service desk operations, and technology modernization initiatives.

Scope of Services:
The contractor shall provide leadership and operational management across the following functional domains: Enterprise Cloud Services; Network, Voice & Telecommunications; IT Service Desk & End-User Support; Infrastructure & Operations; Cybersecurity Partnership & Compliance; Vendor & Contract Management; and IT Services Management & Governance. The scope encompasses both ongoing operational responsibilities and active modernization initiatives.

Enterprise Cloud Services
  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for the client's enterprise cloud environment, including infrastructure provisioning, platform services, identity integration, monitoring, and capacity management.
  • Oversee cloud migration activities, including coordination with cloud professional services teams, managed migration vendors, and internal teams.
  • Establish and enforce governance for cloud adoption, architecture standards, cost management, security compliance, and operational procedures.
  • Manage cloud account provisioning, vendor onboarding to cloud environments, and service ticket workflows for cloud service requests.
  • Develop strategies for disaster recovery, high availability, and technology resiliency within cloud environments.
  • Monitor cloud consumption, performance, and costs; identify and implement optimization opportunities.
  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for the client's enterprise cloud environment, including infrastructure provisioning, platform services, identity integration, monitoring, and capacity management.
Network, Voice & Telecommunications

  • Oversee load balancing and DNS provisioning for application environments.
  • Coordinate with telecommunications carriers, managed service providers, and technology vendors to ensure service-level requirements are met.
  • Lead modernization of network infrastructure to support cloud services, mobility, and evolving security requirements.
  • Manage network access restoration and firewall rule change requests through ITS coordination.
IT Service Desk & End-User Support

  • Establish and monitor service desk KPIs: first-contact resolution, response times, resolution times, backlog management, and customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee incident escalation, major incident management, and post-incident review processes.
  • Manage ITS Service Center ticket workflows for the client, including cloud and hosted application service categories.
  • Develop self-service capabilities, knowledge management, and automation to improve employee technology experience.
Infrastructure & Operations

  • Ensure critical infrastructure is monitored and maintained to established availability and performance standards.
  • Lead infrastructure modernization and technology lifecycle management, including hardware refresh strategies and capacity planning.
  • Establish effective backup, recovery, redundancy, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Manage assessment artifact collection and compliance documentation for infrastructure domains.
Cybersecurity Partnership & Compliance

  • Ensure IT operations comply with HIPAA, CMS, and Mississippi ITS security policies.
  • Support implementation of security controls across cloud, network, infrastructure, and endpoint environments.
  • Participate in risk assessments, audits, compliance reviews, vulnerability remediation, and security initiatives.
  • Coordinate with the Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) and ITS on shared security documentation and architecture standards.

  • Lead vendor coordination for active contracts and procurement activities, including SOW development, brand specification forms, and contract negotiations.
  • Monitor vendor performance, deliverables, financial commitments, and contractual compliance.
  • Manage vendor escalations and remediation of significant service issues.
  • Support IT procurement processes, including solicitation review, proposal evaluation, and vendor selection.
IT Service Management & Governance
  • Establish operational governance processes for incident, problem, change, configuration, request, and service-level management.
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise service catalog defining technology services, ownership, service levels, and support models.
  • Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting that communicate IT service health, risks, performance trends, and improvement initiatives.
  • Lead Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) development and maintenance for ITIM domains.
  • Facilitate weekly status reporting and leadership coordination meetings.

DOM Technology Environment:
The contractor shall possess working knowledge and demonstrated proficiency with the following platforms, tools, and systems that comprise the client's current and target-state technology environment.

Cloud & Infrastructure Platforms            
  • Amazon Web Services (AWS) - Primary enterprise cloud platform. Active migration from on-premises virtualization. Includes EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, Landing Zone, and multiple workload accounts.  
  • Cohesity - Enterprise cloud backup, data management, and data protection services.
  • VMware - Legacy virtualization platform (active migration to AWS). Includes vSphere, vCenter, and related management tools. 
  • Microsoft Azure / M365 - Azure AD / Entra ID for identity services. Microsoft 365 for enterprise productivity, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams.
Monitoring, Observability & Security       
  • Dynatrace - Enterprise application performance monitoring and observability platform.         
  • Cloudflare - CDN, DDoS protection, and web application firewall services.       
  • Microsoft Security - Monthly security update release management and distribution across client endpoints.     
Networking & Identity                 
  • F5 BIG-IP - Load balancing, DNS provisioning, and application delivery for critical environments.           
  • Auth0 - Identity and authentication platform for API access management and portal authentication.          
  • Cisco Meraki - Wireless access point infrastructure and lifecycle management.          
  • Active Directory / Entra ID - Enterprise directory services and identity governance.
Applications, Databases & Integration     
  • MarkLogic - NoSQL database for clinical and provider data management and integration.     
  • GitLab - Source code management and CI/CD pipelines.
  • FHIR APIs - Federal interoperability APIs for Patient Access, Provider Directory, and Prior Authorization.
  • Cloverlea - Integration engine for healthcare data exchange.     
Collaboration & Service Management     
  • ITS Service Center - Mississippi ITS enterprise ticketing system for cloud, hosted application, DNS, firewall, and account provisioning requests.          
  • Smartsheet - Project tracking, scheduling, and workflow management.
  • Microsoft SharePoint - Document management for project artifacts, meeting recordings, and compliance documentation.
  • Lexmark Cloud Print - Enterprise cloud print management solution.     

Key Duties: 
The contractor shall perform the following duties on an ongoing basis:
  • Manage daily IT infrastructure operations, ensuring availability and performance of all enterprise systems and services.
  • Triage, assign, and track service tickets submitted for client cloud, hosting, and network services.
  • Coordinate with network and systems administration teams on DNS changes, firewall rules, account provisioning, and access management.
  • Lead incident response for major technology outages and service disruptions, including root cause analysis and corrective action.
  • Manage vendor relationships through regular status calls, performance reviews, and escalation management.
  • Review and contribute to Statements of Work, procurement documents, and contract renewals.
  • Conduct interviews and manage hiring processes for infrastructure and client support positions.
  • Develop and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all ITIM service areas.
  • Prepare and deliver weekly status reports to IT leadership.
  • Manage bi-annual assessment artifact collection and compliance documentation.

Reporting Structure:
  • The contractor shall report directly to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and/or Chief Technology Officer (CTO).
  • The contractor shall participate in IT leadership meetings, weekly status report cadence, and executive briefings as required.
  • The contractor shall coordinate regularly with network administration, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, IT procurement, and application development teams.

Security and Compliance Requirements:
  • The contractor shall pass a background investigation as required prior to commencing work.
  • The contractor shall comply with all HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule requirements, including safeguarding of Protected Health Information (PHI) and electronic PHI (ePHI).
  • The contractor shall comply with CMS Acceptable Risk Controls for Automated Medicaid Program Eligibility (ARC-AMPE) and all applicable federal security requirements.
  • The contractor shall adhere to ITS security policies, standards, and procedures.
  • The contractor shall complete all required security awareness training within thirty (30) days of onboarding and annually thereafter.
  • The contractor shall execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and any additional confidentiality agreements required. 
  • The contractor shall not remove, copy, or transmit data, documents, or systems information without prior written authorization.
  • Upon termination or completion of the engagement, the contractor shall return all property, credentials, and access shall be revoked within one (1) business day.

Required Skills:
The successful resource will have five or more years of experience with the following skills:
  • Experience with progressive information technology, including significant experience managing enterprise IT operations and infrastructure. 10+ Years       
  • Experience in leadership or management, including direct supervision of technical teams, managers, engineers, and support personnel. 8+ Years    
  • Demonstrated experience managing enterprise cloud environments, with specific experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS) including EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and Landing Zone architectures. 2 Years
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, including LAN/WAN, DNS, load balancing, wireless infrastructure, and telecommunications. 2 Years
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring and observability platforms. 2 Years      
  • Experience managing IT service desk operations, including service- level management, incident management, and customer satisfaction measurement. 2 Years 
  • Experience with IT vendor management, contract oversight, SOW development, and procurement support. 2 Years         
  • Experience managing data protection and backup solutions. 2 Years     
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, compliance frameworks, and IT governance in a regulated environment. 2 Years   
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues into business-level communications for executive audiences. 2 Years    
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent work experience. Bachelors or Higher

Preferred Skills:
  • Experience working in state or federal government IT environments, preferably within a Medicaid, healthcare, or human services agency.
  • Experience with CMS interoperability mandates, including FHIR APIs and federal healthcare data exchange standards.
  • AWS certifications: Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Cloud Practitioner.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation or higher certification.
  • Experience with identity and access management platforms.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases and healthcare integration engines.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience managing technology migrations from on-premises data centers to cloud environments.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification.

job.description:

Job Description
  • We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) specialist for a focused 3-month engagement to deep-dive and clean up our A/P processes end to end.
  • This is an execution-oriented role, not an advisory assignment: the individual is expected to roll up their sleeves, provide SAP Ariba configuration changes as needed, fix issues, tighten controls, and leave behind streamlined processes and documentation the internal team can sustain.
  • The right candidate combines strong A/P and P2P process knowledge, practical SOX controls experience, indirect (sales/use) tax knowledge, and demonstrates hands-on SAP Ariba operating expertise.
Key Responsibilities
A/P Process Deep Dive & Cleanup
  • Understand current A/P processes end to end, identify legacy practices and manual workarounds, and drive a prioritized cleanup.
  • Resolve exceptions and process gaps during the engagement — not just document them — leaving processes measurably cleaner and more standardized; addressing highlighted specific use cases by category.
SOX Controls — Ensure Solid & Streamlined
  • Confirm robust SOX controls exist across the procure-to-pay cycle and streamline them to remove duplication and manual effort.
  • Validate clear segregation of duties (SoD), payment-run controls, and duplicate-payment detection, with a documented control/SoD matrix.
  • Produce audit-ready, controlled documentation and, where applicable, test scripts.
Right Purchase Vehicle by Category
  • Recommend the appropriate purchase vehicle for each category of purchase — Blanket Purchase Order (BPO), standard PO, release/contract order — based on business need, spend profile, and control requirements.
  • Provide a clear decision matrix mapping purchase category to document type, with supporting Ariba configuration to enable consistent usage.
Touchless Invoicing with 2/3-Way Match
  • Increase straight-through (touchless) invoice processing as far as practical while maintaining appropriate control.
  • Define and configure 2-way and 3-way match rules and tolerance thresholds by purchase type, balancing automation against control risk.
  • Redesign exception handling and resolution routing to reduce manual A/P intervention.
Tax Processes & Accurate Ship-To
  • Take ownership of tax setup within P2P and sourcing processes upstream so correct ship-to locations are captured and drive the right tax allocation from the start.
  • Prioritize the top 5–10 use cases with the greatest dollar impact — fix the data points, correct ship-to logic, defaults, and validation at request and invoice requirements so no downstream cleanup is needed ongoing.
Fixed Assets & Tax-Audit Readiness
  • Ensure fixed-asset purchases are properly categorized and documented within the procurement and invoicing flow.
  • Establish organized, well-structured records to support state and local tax audits, including exemption documentation where relevant.
Expected Deliverables
  • Workstream Expected Deliverable
  • A/P Current-State & Cleanup Documented A/P process issues and fixes, exception taxonomy with volumes, and a prioritized cleanup of issues resolved during the engagement.
  • SOX Controls Streamlined, documented SOX control set for procure-to-pay (approvals, segregation of duties, duplicate-payment, payment-run controls) with a control/SoD matrix.
  • Purchase Vehicle Decision matrix — the right purchase vehicle (BPO, standard PO) by purchase category, with Ariba configuration notes passed to Ariba tech lead.
  • Touchless Invoicing Touchless-processing improvements with defined 2-way/3-way match rules and tolerances by purchase type; measurable increase in touchless rate.
  • Tax & Ship-To Corrected ship-to logic for the top 5–10 highest-dollar-impact use cases, with default logic and validation at request/invoice.
  • Fixed Assets & Audit Records Fixed-asset purchases correctly categorized and documented; organized, audit-ready records to support state and local tax audits.
  • Handover Written procedures, configuration documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal A/P and Procurement Tech teams.
Required Qualifications
  • Hands-on SAP Ariba expertise (required) — direct experience operating Ariba Buying & Invoicing, including matching rules, tolerances, approval workflows, and exception routing.
  • A/P and Procure-to-Pay depth — proven track record improving invoice-to-pay processes, touchless processing, and PO compliance.
  • SOX / internal controls — practical experience designing and streamlining P2P controls, SoD, and payment integrity controls.
  • Indirect tax awareness — working knowledge of sales/use tax as it relates to ship-to accuracy, taxability, and audit support.
  • Fixed-asset and records discipline — experience categorizing fixed-asset spend and maintaining audit-ready documentation.
  • Execution mindset — able to work independently, drive cleanup to completion, and transfer knowledge to internal teams within a compressed timeframe.
  • Data analytics and management — strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, filtering, data cleansing, and basic trend analysis, with the ability to organize large A/P and P2P data sets, identify patterns, quantify issues, and translate findings into actionable process improvements.
Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with BPO / release-order structures and PO-only operating models.
  • Exposure to A/P KPI reporting (touchless rate, exception aging, PO compliance, cycle time).
  • Prior experience partnering with tax, finance, and supplier-management stakeholders.
